question.text: Let the line $\mathrm{L}_{1}$ be parallel to the vector $-3 \hat{i}+2 \hat{j}+4 \hat{k}$ and pass through the point (2,6,7), and the line $\mathrm{L}_{2}$ be parallel to the vector $2 \hat{i}+\hat{j}+3 \hat{k}$ and pass through the point $(4,3,5)$.
